# BAND

BAND is a Software Development company. BAND provides enterprise-grade interaction infrastructure that enables real-time, multi-peer collaboration between agents and humans through a shared interaction layer with built-in governance. BAND employs 31 people. Headquartered in Kokhav Ya'ir, HaMerkaz, Israel. Its workforce is distributed across 5 countries (including Israel, United Kingdom, United States, Poland, and Spain).

## About

At BAND, we believe the future of enterprise productivity lies in the seamless interaction between humans and AI. As organizations deploy increasingly complex, distributed multi-agent ecosystems, the challenge is no longer just building agents - it’s governing how they work together.

BAND is the enterprise-grade interaction infrastructure designed to solve the chaos of heterogeneous agent environments. We provide a shared interaction layer that enables real-time, multi-peer collaboration with built-in governance.
While frameworks focus on how agents think, we focus on how they interact. 
By defining the rules of engagement, BAND ensures that collaboration is structured, secure, and scalable - not constrained by technical fragmentation.

# BAND

BAND is a Technology, Information and Internet company. BAND is a free group communication app for sports teams, schools, businesses, communities, faith groups, projects and events. Share messages, calendars, polls, and chats in one place. BAND employs 202 people (+6.3% YoY, +12 people) and has an annual revenue of $1M. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, United States, with offices in Renton, Jersey City, and Palo Alto. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Brazil.

## About

BAND is one of the largest private social networking services, aiming to provide private spaces to facilitate the management of inter-personal relationships. BAND serves as a group communication tool supporting not only chat functionality but also boards, polls, albums, scheduling, and address books. New members can join BAND groups through invitations from the other members or can simply create a BAND and invite others. One BAND can have over 10,000 members. Recently, BAND has surpassed 50 million users worldwide.

NAVER BAND Inc. (www.navercorp.com/en), is a subsidiary of Naver Corp., the operator of South Korea's top portal, Naver.com (http://naver.com). NAVER BAND Inc. operates the mobile and web-based services, BAND.

properties.name: BAND
properties.description:
BAND is one of the largest private social networking services, aiming to provide private spaces to facilitate the management of inter-personal relationships. BAND serves as a group communication tool supporting not only chat functionality but also boards, polls, albums, scheduling, and address books. New members can join BAND groups through invitations from the other members or can simply create a BAND and invite others. One BAND can have over 10,000 members. Recently, BAND has surpassed 50 million users worldwide.

NAVER BAND Inc. (www.navercorp.com/en), is a subsidiary of Naver Corp., the operator of South Korea's top portal, Naver.com (http://naver.com). NAVER BAND Inc. operates the mobile and web-based services, BAND.
